To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the addition of carboxymethyl cellulase (CMC) to sorghum film can improve the mechanical properties and the FTIR analysis showed that the addition process only occurred in physical.
the addition of 10% CMC concentration in the sorghum starch film can improve the mechanical properties, especially tensile strength.
the addition of 5%, 7.5% and 10% CMC to sorgum film has a good effect on the mechanical properties of sorgums film.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the physical properties of sorghum flour film and its effect with the addition of 5%, 15% and 20% CMC as an edible film.
the effect of CCM addition on the physical properties of sorghum flour film.
the production of edible films from sorghum starch and the addition of carboxymethyl celluloses.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the addition of 10% CMC in sorghum flour can produce a film with the best mechanical properties.
the addition of the CMC to the sorghum flour film has affected the mechanical properties of the film and the addition of C MC did not form new functional groups in the film.
the addition of the CMC to the sorghum starch has improved the physical properties of the film, but the FTIR analysis did not show any chemical interaction between the CMC and starch.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the addition of 10% CMC to the starch of sorghum flour can increase tensile strength and elasticity of edible film, and reduce the elongation of edible film.
the addition of carboxymethyl celluloses has an effect on the mechanical properties of sorghum flour film, but does not form any new groups.
the addition of carboxymethyl celluloses (CMC) to sorghum film has affected the mechanical properties of the film.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of 10% CMC concentration is the optimum concentration for improving the tensile strength and elongation of sorghum flour film.
the addition of carboxymethyl cellulase (CMC) to sorgum starch film can increase the tensile strength and elasticity of the film.
the addition of carboxymethyl celluloses can improve the mechanical properties such as tensile strength, elasticity and elongation of the edible film.
